blocks.summary: Since you're hunting for the viral Matcha Cheese Cloud in Bengaluru, I've found the top-rated cafes and bubble tea spots serving this creamy, fluffy delight — from premium matcha bars to cozy neighborhood gems.

cards.title: Neko and Matcha Cafe, S.G. Palya
cards.why: Perfect 5-star rating with the most affordable premium matcha drinks in the city.

cards.title: Moo Cha Kura, Koramangala
cards.why: Specialized matcha bar with consistent quality and a dedicated cheese cloud menu.

cards.title: Turtle Matcha, Indiranagar
cards.why: High review volume with a trendy Indiranagar vibe and reliable cheese cloud preparation.

cards.title: Matcha Mori, Richmond Town
cards.why: Upscale matcha bar known for premium grade matcha and artisanal cheese cloud toppings.

cards.title: Latcha, JP Nagar
cards.why: Great value spot with a loyal following and consistently fluffy cheese cloud layers.

cards.title: Boba Bhai, Rajarajeshwari Nagar
cards.why: Korean bubble tea house that nails the cheese cloud texture with boba options.

blocks.conclusion: For the absolute best experience, start with Neko and Matcha Cafe — it's the only spot with a perfect 5-star rating and the most affordable premium matcha drinks.
